title: Heavenly PvP
description: This is the heavenly pvp resource pack which makes all your pvp items have a twist of Christianity!
body: Welcome to Heavenly PvP which adds a Christian twist to your pvp tools! I hope you enjoy!!! I originally made this pack for Itzfragged. I worked very hard on this texture pack and it amazes me that im even here uploading it so it would mean a ton of you would download it.
